dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Wow, Genius Invokation attracts quite the following. The Tavern is packed with players! Ooh, I should go up to a few of them and ask for an interview — No, uh, I mean, an overview! Yep, an overview of the game...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: You're leaving? I'm gonna stay for a little while longer. I just feel like... I could've asked better questions earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Looks like I've won this round. Heh, guess you could say I've learned a thing or two from all the reading I do, so it's best not to underestimate me.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: That last move you did... I've never seen it before! Tell me everything about it! I'm interviewing a Genius Invokation player this weekend, and I think this could be a great conversation starter!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Absolutely! I've been waiting for the chance to play Genius Invokation with you!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: So this is what it feels like to win a game of Genius Invokation... Hmm, not bad. I should write an article about it.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I lost... *sigh* A few wrong moves and you lose the whole match. Genius Invokation is so complicated...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm more than ready. After all, I made sure to build a deck that combines only the best of the best!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: I won! As expected, hehe. I put the deck together myself, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Huh, every card in my deck is super impressive on its own. Working together, you'd think the result would be even more impressive...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...
